Visit note | 2025-01-01 09:00 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Mita Ghosh, 55, female. The patient presents complaining of a gnawing pain in her upper belly that typically eases after she eats. This discomfort started after weeks of taking painkillers for back pain in Savar, where she works as a tailor. She has no other comorbidities.
